# omada_firmware_upgrade_schedule (Resource)

Manages a periodic firmware upgrade schedule (Global View → Firmware → Periodic Update).

At the scheduled time the controller upgrades every device of the listed `models` on the listed `sites` to the newest firmware in the channel. Devices reboot as they upgrade, so pick a maintenance window.

**Controller-scoped:** there is no `site` attribute, because a schedule belongs to the controller and names its sites itself. This is not the same setting as `omada_site_settings.auto_upgrade_enable`, which upgrades a site's devices whenever the controller notices a release, with no schedule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Upgrade the AP and the switch to the newest stable firmware every Sunday at
# 04:15 site time, inside a maintenance window. Devices reboot as they upgrade.
resource "omada_firmware_upgrade_schedule" "weekly" {
  sites       = ["Default"]
  models      = ["EAP670(US) v2.0", "ES205G v1.20"]
  timing_type = 2 # weekly
  day_of_week = 0 # Sunday
  hour        = 4
  minute      = 15
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hour` (Number) Hour of the run, 0-23, in the site's local time.
- `models` (Set of String) Device models to upgrade, as the controller names them (its `compoundModel`), e.g. `EAP670(US) v2.0` or `ES205G v1.20`. Each must be present on at least one of the `sites`: the controller only offers models it has adopted there.
- `sites` (Set of String) Names of the sites the schedule covers.
- `timing_type` (Number) How often it runs: `1` daily, `2` weekly, `3` monthly, `4` yearly.

### Optional

- `channel` (Number) Firmware channel. `0` is Stable, the only channel the controller offers here.
- `day_of_month` (Number) Monthly and yearly schedules: day of the month, 1-31. Ignored otherwise.
- `day_of_week` (Number) Weekly schedules: `0` Sunday through `6` Saturday. Ignored otherwise.
- `minute` (Number) Minute of the run, 0-59.
- `month_of_year` (Number) Yearly schedules: `1` January through `12` December. Ignored otherwise.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by schedule id. The web UI does not show it; list the schedules with
# GET /{omadacId}/api/v2/upgrade/autoCheck to find it.
terraform import omada_firmware_upgrade_schedule.weekly 0123456789abcdef01234567
```
